pool.text: Yi Seong-gye changed the name of his Kingdom from Goryeo to Joseon.
Yi Seong-gye chose Hanyang instead of Muak and construction of the city began.
Some major palaces, including Gyeongbokgung, were finished during its early construction stages.
The Fortress Wall surrounding Hanyang was partially finished around this time.
Gojong proclaimed Korea as the Korean Empire and Seoul was temporarily called Hwang Seong.
Japan annexed Korea after the annexation treaty and renamed the city Gyeongseong.
Yeongdeungpo District was annexed into Seoul to function as an industrial complex for factories.
Gimpo International Airport opened as an airfield for the Japanese Imperial Army.
The American military assumed control of Korea following liberation from Japanese colonial rule.
Seoul fell to North Korean forces in the June First Battle of Seoul.
Seoul fell to Chinese-North Korean forces and was recaptured by UN forces.
A flood of refugees swelled the population of the city and metropolitan area.
Gimpo International Airport opened for civil aircraft.
Seoul went through two major expansions that established the shape and size of present-day Seoul.
Seoul Central Mosque opened in the city.
Korea World Trade Center Complex was established in time for the Seoul Olympics.
Changdeokgung was added to the UNESCO World Heritage List as an outstanding palace architecture example.
Incheon International Airport opened in Yeongjong island.
The Constitutional Court of Korea declared that Seoul must remain the national capital.
Cheonggyecheon stream was restored by an urban revival project.
